text.tspan: Effect of gov't effectiveness & healthcare spending on child mortality, 2014
Government Effectiveness captures perceptions of the quality of public services, the quality of the civil service and
the degree of its independence from political pressures, and the quality of policy formulation and implementation.
Child mortality – the share of children who die before reaching the age of five – is shown by the size of the bubbles.
Current health expenditure per capita, PPP (current international $)
Government Effectiveness (units of a standard normal
Source: Worldbank via the Quality of Government dataset, World Health Organization (via World Bank), UN Inter-agency Group for Child
